title: Kalaam : Janab Raza Ali Sohai Sahab
body:
Haaye Hussain Pyaase Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Roke Fatima Zehra(s.a) Peet'ti hai sar apna
1. Ghar bula ke mehmaa'n ko di dagha layeno'n ne
khatm kardi zulmo'n ki inteha layeno'n ne
Baad e Qatl Sarwar(a.s) ka ghar ka ghar jala daala
<<MINI>>
Haaye Hussain Pyaase Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Itne kuch diye sadme Fatima(s.a) ke jaayi ko
Sab tadapte the bacche boond boond paani ko
Qaid karke itrat ki, cheenli saro'n se rida
<<MINI>>
Haaye Hussain Pyaase Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jab se bawafa Abbas(a.s) sogaya labe darya
Ghir gaya layeno'n me jaane fatima Zehra(S.a)
Ek jaane sarwar(a.s) par, har taraf se tha hamla
<<MINI>>
Haaye Hussain Pyaase Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hogaya juda sheh se ham shabihe paighambar
saamne nigaho'n ke jo pada tha reti par
Jo zaeef hatho'n par , khud uthaliya laasha
<<MINI>>
Haaye Hussain Pyaase Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Di sada jo halmin ki chal pade Ali Asghar(a.s)
Hurmala(l.a) ka teer aaya johi halqe Asghar(a.s) par
Chehre par mala lekar , Khoon halqe Asghar(a.s) ka
<<MINI>>
Haaye Hussain Pyaase Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Janab Raza Ali Sohai Sahab
